headlines.description: Elliot Anderson struck as Manchester City ended their losing run but more points were dropped as Fulham claimed a 1-1 draw at the Etihad Stadium on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Man City draw 1-1 with Fulham, City's winless streak extends to four matches

headlines.description: Bournemouth extended their winning run to nine in all competitions as Evanilson scored for the sixth Premier League game in a row in a 2-0 win over Nottingham Forest.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bournemouth win again, beat Nottingham Forest 2-0 to climb to fourth in Premier League table

headlines.description: Aston Villa and Sunderland drew a blank in their Premier League match at Villa Park.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sunderland stay in bottom three after bore draw with Aston Villa

headlines.description: Noah Okafor scored twice as Leeds beat Chelsea 4-1 to record their first Premier League win at Stamford Bridge in 27 years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Noah Okafor stars as Leeds hammer Chelsea 4-1 at Stamford Bridge

headlines.description: Thomas Frank suffered defeat in his first game as Crystal Palace boss as Dwight McNeil's late own goal condemned them to a 3-2 loss at Coventry.
headlines.shortLinkText: Coventry beat Crystal Palace 3-2 as Thomas Frank loses first game in charge of the Eagles

headlines.description: Luca Williams-Barnett lived up to the hype with a sparking display on his full debut for Tottenham to inspire a 2-0 win over Ipswich.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wonderkid Williams-Barnett inspires Spurs to comfortable win over Ipswich

headlines.description: Noni Madueke snatched a 2-2 draw for Arsenal after Newcastle produced a stunning second-half turnaround to claim a deserved point against the Premier League leaders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Noni Madueke rescues a point for Arsenal against Newcastle in thrilling 2-2 draw
